name: phonebridge
description: 快投屏 — Windows → iPhone AirPlay 镜像 + BLE HID 输入

scripts.tauri:dev: node scripts/prepare-sidecars.mjs && node scripts/bundle-uxplay-runtime.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build:ble: node scripts/prepare-sidecars.mjs --download && node scripts/bundle-uxplay-runtime.mjs && tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:wda: node scripts/prepare-sidecars.mjs --download --require-wda && node scripts/bundle-uxplay-runtime.mjs && tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:dmg:ble: node scripts/prepare-sidecars.mjs --download && node scripts/bundle-uxplay-runtime.mjs && CI=true tauri build --bundles dmg && node scripts/sign-macos-dmg.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:dmg:wda: node scripts/prepare-sidecars.mjs --download --require-wda && node scripts/bundle-uxplay-runtime.mjs && CI=true tauri build --bundles dmg && node scripts/sign-macos-dmg.mjs
